displayTitle: Who's Who: A Pocket Guide to the Characters of the Star Wars Trilogy
synopsis: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away, Luke Skywalker and a heroic group of Rebels battled Darth Vader and the evil forces of the Galactic Empire . . .Now the unforgettable characters of the Star Wars trilogy come to life again inside this pocket guide! Learn all about Han Solo, Chewbacca, Princess Leia, Yoda, and many others - from Admiral Ackbar to Zuckuss.Star Wars Who's Who is a perfect companion for all fans of the original trilogy, and a great primer for George Lucas' new series of films about the early adventures of Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker!
title: Star Wars Who's Who: A Pocket Guide to the Characters of the Star Wars Trilogy
